description: Reference styles - the standard aesthetic families of the modern web. Borrowed vocabulary for looks your own inspo doesn't cover yet. Family name in a brief carries fifty decisions.

styles.name: Editorial Minimalism
styles.deployFor: Developer tools, B2B SaaS, buyers who distrust marketing
styles.imageStyle: minimal product UI screenshot floating on a calm near-white ground, soft single shadow, no scene, no decoration
styles.risk: Shrink the headline below what feels safe and let whitespace carry the page

styles.name: Warm Editorial
recognize: serif body text, not just headlines
styles.deployFor: Knowledge tools, reading products, depth-over-speed brands
styles.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] as a warm minimal illustration on cream paper ground, terracotta and clay tones, soft edges, book-plate composition
styles.risk: Set the entire body in serif, not just display
styles.warning: Cream + serif + terracotta is now an AI-default cluster - legitimate family, dangerous reflex

styles.name: Terminal-Core
styles.deployFor: Dev tools, infra - buyers who live in a terminal
styles.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] rendered as glowing phosphor-green ASCII art on a near-black terminal screen, subtle scanlines, CRT glow
styles.risk: Make the hero an actual live terminal session typing itself

styles.name: Swiss / International
styles.deployFor: Portfolios, foundries, institutions - clarity as product
styles.imageStyle: flat geometric composition: black bars and one red square on white, mathematical grid alignment, no texture, no depth
styles.risk: One typeface, three weights, one red square - nothing else

styles.name: Brutalist (Raw Web)
styles.deployFor: Personal sites, engineering blogs, ironic luxury
styles.risk: Ship default Times New Roman and let content be the only design

styles.name: Neo-Brutalism
recognize: saturated flat fills: yellow, pink, lime
styles.deployFor: Creator tools, indie products, friendly energy without corporate polish
styles.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] as a flat sticker-style illustration with thick black outlines, saturated flat fills, hard offset shadow, white or loud solid background
styles.risk: Give every element a hard 8px offset shadow and zero border-radius

styles.name: Neon Brutalist / Editorial Chaos
styles.deployFor: Media brands, culture products, liner-notes audiences
styles.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] photo with harsh duotone treatment in magenta and black, aggressive crop, halftone grain, zine-xerox quality
styles.risk: Pair a condensed all-caps grotesque with an italic serif in the same headline

styles.name: Data-Dense Pro
styles.imageStyle: dense dark dashboard UI with glowing sparkline charts, amber and green state colors, tabular data grids, dark blue-gray panels
styles.risk: Make a live chart the hero image - real data, no illustration

styles.name: Cinematic Dark
styles.deployFor: Launches, hardware, AI/creative tools - desire before spec sheet
styles.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] emerging from near-black darkness, single dramatic rim light, atmospheric haze, film-grade contrast, cinematic 2.35:1 crop energy
styles.risk: Weight 100 display type at 8rem with .3em letterspacing

styles.name: Glass / Soft-Futurism
styles.deployFor: Consumer apps, OS-adjacent products - mass-market premium
styles.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] behind frosted glass panels, soft pastel gradient atmosphere (blue-lilac-peach), translucent layered depth, gentle studio light
styles.risk: Stack three translucent layers deep and let content blur through them

styles.name: Playful Color / Illustrated
styles.deployFor: Consumer education, wellness - anywhere anxiety is the enemy
styles.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] as a friendly flat illustration with rounded shapes, high-saturation palette on white, subtle paper-cut depth, cheerful character energy
styles.risk: Give the product a mascot and let it react to user actions

styles.name: Magazine / Print DNA
styles.deployFor: Longform content, newsletters, culture brands - words are the product
styles.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] as an archival editorial photograph, muted print reproduction quality, slight ink-on-newsprint texture, composed for a three-column broadsheet layout
styles.risk: Open the page with a full masthead and a drop cap like a Sunday edition
